title: Fictional Mafia Movie Posters
description: Posters for fictional mafia films, each telling its story through a single object, with titles in Italian and English.
study_intro: Telling a whole film with one object.

study.label: Composition
study.text: A single central object carries the story, with the title set small and quiet around it.

study.label: Type
study.text: Bilingual titles in Italian and English, set in a restrained serif.

study.label: Color
study.text: Flat, flag-like fields of red, green and white, with blood red as the only accent.
